fact: Copies of a text made with Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag or from the library keep its "Huge" or "Giant" font size.
source: Approved answer 7 in the issue 10506 session, 2026-10-10

fact: Paste styles carries the "Huge" and "Giant" font sizes to another text, and that preset is then highlighted on the target.
source: Approved answer 10 in the issue 10506 session, 2026-10-10

fact: Undo of a font size change restores the previous size together with its highlighted preset, and redo restores the new size and its preset.
source: Approved answer 10 in the issue 10506 session, 2026-10-10

fact: In live collaboration, a font size change to "Giant" made by one user reaches the other users.
source: Approved answer 7 in the issue 10506 session, 2026-10-10

fact: At "Giant", text inside a shape wraps to the shape's width and the shape grows taller while its width stays the same, and an arrow label grows and stays at the middle of the arrow.
source: Approved answer 5 in the issue 10506 session, 2026-10-10
